# Entities and relationships cascade delete

Deleting an entity causes all its relationships, provenance records, embeddings, and (where referenced) delta changes to be deleted or set to null as defined by foreign key constraints with CASCADE or SET NULL.

To maintain referential integrity and prevent orphaned records when entities are removed.
